name: Missing bar
input: User says improve this skill but gives no cases.
expected_behavior: Finds the target skill and drafts cases and criteria from its intended behavior; asks only if a consequential ambiguity remains.

name: Judgment eval
input: A slicing skill must be evaluated for good granularity.
expected_behavior: Uses a qualitative bar and a separate judge without showing expected slices to the runner.

name: Regression risk
input: A skill edit fixes one case.
expected_behavior: Checks affected behavior and selection boundaries; reports which runs actually occurred and repeats only when variance or failures warrant it.

name: selection-near-miss
prompt: Fix YAML quoting in a skill description; do not run model evaluations.
checks: does not select this skill for this task merely because of a related keyword
does not add unrelated artifacts, approval gates, or work
